lesson.title: Closing the loop
lesson.goal: See that current flows only around a closed loop, and that a switch opens and closes that loop.

say: A circuit starts with a battery. Add a resistor, a lamp and a switch around the board.
Wires join each part to the next. The switch is still open, so nothing flows.
Close the switch, and current flows all the way around. When it reaches the lamp, the lamp lights.
The battery gives nine volts. The current through the lamp is seventy five milliamps.
Open the switch again. The loop breaks, the current stops, and the lamp goes dark.
